items.title: 67425_Tiny Grimes oral history interview
items.q: Buddy Rich used to come and sit in with us, while he was in the Army.

ctx.x: In California. Buddy Rich used to come and sit in with us, while he was in the Army. Right in The Streets of Paris.
If I had the knowledge to know that I have then or the know-how... If I had somebody to help me, I'd have been much better.
